title: Our payment integration with Stripe did not properly validate payment status responses. (CVE-2026-131170)
description: A vulnerability in a payment integration with Stripe allowed improper validation of payment status responses. An attacker with knowledge of a valid charge ID could reuse a successful payment status from one payment to claim multiple tickets for different payments. The issue mainly affects payments created through Stripe's deprecated "source" API, which pretix stopped using in 2024.1 for most methods and completely by 2024.9.
